preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is either n (tree) or n+1 (unicyclic components), consistent with the graph being connected and each vertex belonging to at most one simple cycle.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The number of provided edges matches m.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output_values)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[i] == min_{T} (max_{leaf in T} dist_T(i, leaf)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each node i (0-indexed in output), the value is the minimum possible value of the maximum distance from node i to any leaf in a spanning tree T obtained by removing edges from the original graph. The minimization is over all valid spanning trees T, and the maximization is over all leaves in T.
